targets.rawSql: SELECT agent, hit_rate, r_avg, sharpe, max_dd_pct, score, provisional FROM lake.backtest_attribution_daily WHERE asof_date = (SELECT MAX(asof_date) FROM lake.backtest_attribution_daily) ORDER BY score DESC
SELECT asof_date AS time, agent AS metric, sum(pnl_r) OVER (PARTITION BY agent ORDER BY asof_date) AS value FROM lake.backtest_attribution_daily ORDER BY 1
